dialogues.jp: 夢の終わりのその後。
dialogues.en: It was the tree I made a promise to.
dialogues.text: It was the tree I made a promise to.

dialogues.en: The tree that I promised to protect Nemu under.
dialogues.text: The tree that I promised to protect Nemu under.

dialogues.jp: この初音島で桜が枯れた。
dialogues.en: I came to see it.
dialogues.text: I came to see it.

dialogues.jp: それは約束の木。
音夢を守ると約束した木。
dialogues.en: After I had a happy dream, I felt good, and......
dialogues.text: After I had a happy dream, I felt good, and......

dialogues.jp: それを見に来た。
dialogues.en: Then I become sad realizing the reality.
dialogues.text: Then I become sad realizing the reality.

dialogues.jp: 幸福な夢を見た後は気分がよくて――。
dialogues.en: I pulled out the letter from my pocket.
dialogues.text: I pulled out the letter from my pocket.

dialogues.jp: 現実に気づいて物悲しくなる。
dialogues.en:
The sender and the receiver of the letter had the same
addresses.
dialogues.text:
The sender and the receiver of the letter had the same
addresses.

dialogues.en: It was a letter from Nemu to me.
dialogues.text: It was a letter from Nemu to me.

dialogues.jp: 俺はポケットから手紙を出した。
dialogues.en: ---- Don't open it if I'm here.
dialogues.text: ---- Don't open it if I'm here.

dialogues.jp: 差出人と受取人の住所が同じ手紙。
dialogues.en: That was what it said on the envelope.
dialogues.text: That was what it said on the envelope.

dialogues.jp: 音夢から俺への手紙。
dialogues.en: I wonder what the mailman thought about it.
dialogues.text: I wonder what the mailman thought about it.

dialogues.jp: ――もし、私がいる場合はあけないで下さい。
dialogues.en: I decided to open the letter.
dialogues.text: I decided to open the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『親愛なる兄さんへ』
dialogues.en: "Dear niisan."
dialogues.text: "Dear niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『この手紙を読んでいるのは春ですか？　それ
　とも、もう冬になっていますか？』
dialogues.en:
"I wonder if it's spring or winter by the time you read this
letter."
dialogues.text:
"I wonder if it's spring or winter by the time you read this
letter."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『とにかく、ちゃんとご飯を食べていますか？
　遅刻しないで学園に通えていますか？』
dialogues.en: "Are you eating well? Are you going to school on time?"
dialogues.text: "Are you eating well? Are you going to school on time?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『うん。気になるよ……』
dialogues.en: "Yes, I'm worried about you......"
dialogues.text: "Yes, I'm worried about you......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『花は枯れるほうがきれいだと言うけど、私は
　やっぱり枯れなくてもきれいだと思います』
dialogues.en:
"People say that flowers are beautiful because they die, but
I think they're still beautiful even if they don't die."
dialogues.text:
"People say that flowers are beautiful because they die, but
I think they're still beautiful even if they don't die."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『あははは……なに書いてるんだろうね』
dialogues.en: "Hahaha...... what am I talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Hahaha...... what am I talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『あのね、桜の花を見ちゃうと、なんとなく私
　を思い出しちゃうかも知れないけど』
dialogues.en:
"You know, you may remember me when you look at the cherry
blossom, but."
dialogues.text:
"You know, you may remember me when you look at the cherry
blossom, but."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『そんなの１年に１回くらいでいいから――う
　ん』
dialogues.en: "Keep it once a year, or something like that......"
dialogues.text: "Keep it once a year, or something like that......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『ごめんなさい……って謝ると怒ると思うけど、
　やっぱりごめんなさい』
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry...... You might be upset if I apologize, but I'm
sorry."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry...... You might be upset if I apologize, but I'm
sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『ごめんなさい』
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『ごめんなさい……』
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『ずるいよね』
dialogues.en: "I think it's unfair."
dialogues.text: "I think it's unfair."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『この手紙はずるい』
dialogues.en: "This letter's unfair."
dialogues.text: "This letter's unfair."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『忘れて欲しいと言いながら、これで兄さんの
　心に、また私が刻まれることを知っている』
dialogues.en:
"I'm telling you that you should forget about me, but I know
you'll remember me even more by reading this letter."
dialogues.text:
"I'm telling you that you should forget about me, but I know
you'll remember me even more by reading this letter."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『あの、兄さんと見てたドラマ覚えてる？』
dialogues.en: "Do you remember that soap opera we saw together?"
dialogues.text: "Do you remember that soap opera we saw together?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『私の嫌いだった部分を、私が演じてしまって
　るよね』
dialogues.en: "I think I'm acting the part I hated now."
dialogues.text: "I think I'm acting the part I hated now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『……うん。よく分からなくなってきた』
dialogues.en: "Well...... I'm not sure what I want to talk about."
dialogues.text: "Well...... I'm not sure what I want to talk about."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『えっとね、言いたいことはひとつなの』
dialogues.en: "Well, there's only one thing I want to say."
dialogues.text: "Well, there's only one thing I want to say."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『もし、私と兄さんがすれ違って会えなかった
　ら兄さんは後悔すると思ったから』
dialogues.en: "I thought you'd regret it if you couldn't find me."
dialogues.text: "I thought you'd regret it if you couldn't find me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『だから気にしないでください』
dialogues.en: "Please don't be so sad."
dialogues.text: "Please don't be so sad."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『私は幸せ者でした』
dialogues.en: "I was really happy."
dialogues.text: "I was really happy."

dialogues.jp:
ふと、その辺りの文字の下に、消しゴムで消し
た跡を見つけた。
dialogues.en:
Then, I found a mark which was erased by an eraser under
that line.
dialogues.text:
Then, I found a mark which was erased by an eraser under
that line.

dialogues.jp: 紙を光に透かす。
dialogues.en: I held the letter against the light.
dialogues.text: I held the letter against the light.

dialogues.jp:
桜の花を抜けて、ほの赤く染まった光に文字が
浮かぶ。
dialogues.en:
I could see her writing if I held the letter up to the light
streaming through the cherry tree, tinted red by its
blossoms.
dialogues.text:
I could see her writing if I held the letter up to the light
streaming through the cherry tree, tinted red by its
blossoms.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『もし、叶うのなら――』
dialogues.en: "If my wish could come true......"
dialogues.text: "If my wish could come true......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『私は桜の木に生まれ変わってでもいいから、
　兄さんと一緒にいたい』
dialogues.en:
"I want to be with you, even if I was reborn as a cherry
tree."
dialogues.text:
"I want to be with you, even if I was reborn as a cherry
tree."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『……一緒にいたかった』
dialogues.en: "I wanted to be with you......"
dialogues.text: "I wanted to be with you......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『何年も、何十年も……』
dialogues.en: "For many years, and decades......"
dialogues.text: "For many years, and decades......"

dialogues.jp: そこで途切れていた。
dialogues.en: And that was the end of it.
dialogues.text: And that was the end of it.

dialogues.jp: 最後の文章を読んで、思わず笑ってしまった。
dialogues.en: I read the last line and it made me laugh.
dialogues.text: I read the last line and it made me laugh.

dialogues.jp: 「あいつ……」
どこまでも青い空を見上げる。
dialogues.en: I looked up at the blue sky.
dialogues.text: I looked up at the blue sky.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『最後にお節介ですが――』
dialogues.en: "I know this isn't my business, but......"
dialogues.text: "I know this isn't my business, but......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『妹に操なんて立てないで、ちゃんと新しい恋
　人作りなさいよ』
dialogues.en: "Don't feel guilty, and you should have a girlfriend."
dialogues.text: "Don't feel guilty, and you should have a girlfriend."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『世話焼きの妹より』
dialogues.en: "From your nosy sister."
dialogues.text: "From your nosy sister."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『大好きな兄さんへ』
dialogues.en: "To my dear niisan."
dialogues.text: "To my dear niisan."

dialogues.jp: ◆お別れの後の手紙◆
dialogues.en: ◆After the end of my dream.◆
dialogues.text: ◆After the end of my dream.◆

dialogues.jp: 枯れた桜の木の前で音夢からの手紙の封を切る。

手紙にこめられた音夢の想い。その恥ずかしい
までに真っ直ぐな想いに思わず笑みがこぼれた
のだった。
dialogues.en: The cherry tree died on Hatsune Island.
dialogues.text: The cherry tree died on Hatsune Island.
